data_a.situation: Cover is needed for the finishing bench while an apprentice is at a booked training day, and the choice between the two workable options belongs to the workroom manager.
known_facts: Petra Somyk's block-work training day is Monday 13 October, 09:00 to 17:00, already agreed and paid for.
Option 1: Ilva Renaudin covers finishing 09:00 to 13:00 and the Marchmont Enclosure sample slips to Tuesday 14 October.
Option 2: the coordinator covers finishing and the Ardhu Lane stock count moves to Wednesday 15 October, with nothing else affected.
The Marchmont sample has a week of float; the stock count has none after Wednesday 15 October.
Ilva Renaudin is owed two working days' notice of any change to her bench hours.
constraints: Re-allocating another maker's bench hours is the workroom manager's decision.
Moving the Ardhu Lane stock count is the workroom manager's decision.
The coordinator may cover the finishing bench personally without approval.
